author: Inquire II
title: KKT-Guided Nudging (SOTA Base): Two-Stage Relaxation & Re-densification (Inquire II)
abstract: This experiment implements a two-stage KKT-guided nudging strategy starting from the SLSQP SOTA (2.6295720). In Stage 1 ('Relaxation'), a moderate discouraging nudge (`beta_discourage=1e2`) is applied to the low-leverage `pair (13,17)` constraint, aiming to break it and deform the packing. In Stage 2 ('Re-densification'), the resulting configuration is used as an initial guess for an unpenalized SLSQP optimization, allowing the system to re-densify into a new local optimum. The objective is to identify if this process can lead to a novel or higher-scoring packing by exploring adjacent basins of attraction.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
import sys
import pandas as pd

sys.path.append('storage/inquire/circle_packing')

from slsqp_utils import pack_to_z, z_to_pack, objective, constraint_boundary, constraint_nonoverlap
from initial_guesses import generate_systematic_seed
from config import N_CIRCLES, SLSQP_OPTIONS, TRUST_CONSTR_OPTIONS, BOUNDS, CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP, CONSTRAINTS_FOR_TRUST_CONSTR, SAFETY_FACTOR, TOL_VAL, ATOL_SLACK
from kkt_analysis import extract_slsqp_kkt_multipliers, get_slsqp_sota_optimal_z_vector
from objectives import penalized_objective_v36 # This is the CORRECTED version

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    print("--- Starting KKT-Guided Nudging (SOTA Base): Two-Stage Relaxation & Re-densification ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    N = N_CIRCLES

    # --- 1. Get SLSQP SOTA optimal z-vector as initial guess ---
    print("\n===== Stage 1: Loading SLSQP SOTA Optimal Packing as Initial Guess =====", file=sys.stdout)
    z_sota_base = get_slsqp_sota_optimal_z_vector(N=N_CIRCLES)
    
    initial_centers_sota, initial_radii_raw_sota = z_to_pack(z_sota_base)
    initial_radii_sota = initial_radii_raw_sota * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_initial_sota = np.sum(initial_radii_sota)
    print(f"SLSQP SOTA Base Score: {score_initial_sota:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    
    # --- Stage 1: Relaxation (Discouraging Nudge) ---
    print("\n===== Stage 1: Relaxation (Discouraging Nudge on Pair (13,17)) =====", file=sys.stdout)
    targets_to_encourage_stage1 = [] 
    targets_to_discourage_stage1 = [(13, 17)] 

    alpha_encourage_stage1 = 0 
    beta_discourage_stage1 = 1e2 # Moderate discouragement
    EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN_stage1 = 1e-6 
    EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN_stage1 = 0.001 

    current_slsqp_options_stage1 = SLSQP_OPTIONS.copy()
    current_slsqp_options_stage1['maxiter'] = 1500

    res_stage1 = minimize(
        penalized_objective_v36,
        z_sota_base, # Start from the SLSQP SOTA packing
        args=(N_CIRCLES, targets_to_encourage_stage1, targets_to_discourage_stage1, 
              alpha_encourage_stage1, beta_discourage_stage1, EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN_stage1, EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN_stage1),
        method='SLSQP', 
        bounds=BOUNDS, 
        constraints=CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP, 
        options=current_slsqp_options_stage1
    )
    
    nudged_centers_stage1, nudged_radii_raw_stage1 = z_to_pack(res_stage1.x)
    final_radii_nudged_stage1 = nudged_radii_raw_stage1 * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_stage1 = np.sum(final_radii_nudged_stage1)

    print(f"Stage 1 Success: {res_stage1.success}, Message: {res_stage1.message}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Stage 1 Final Score (Relaxed): {score_stage1:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Score Change from SOTA base (Stage 1): {score_stage1 - score_initial_sota:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    
    # --- Stage 2: Re-densification (Unpenalized Optimization) ---
    print("\n===== Stage 2: Re-densification (Unpenalized Optimization) =====", file=sys.stdout)
    # Use the result from Stage 1 as initial guess
    z_initial_guess_stage2 = res_stage1.x

    current_slsqp_options_stage2 = SLSQP_OPTIONS.copy()
    current_slsqp_options_stage2['maxiter'] = 1500 # Ensure sufficient iterations for re-densification

    res_stage2 = minimize(
        objective, # Use the original, unpenalized objective
        z_initial_guess_stage2, 
        method='SLSQP', 
        bounds=BOUNDS, 
        constraints=CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP, 
        options=current_slsqp_options_stage2
    )
    
    nudged_centers_stage2, nudged_radii_raw_stage2 = z_to_pack(res_stage2.x)
    final_radii_nudged_stage2 = nudged_radii_raw_stage2 * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_stage2 = np.sum(final_radii_nudged_stage2)

    print(f"Stage 2 Success: {res_stage2.success}, Message: {res_stage2.message}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Stage 2 Final Score (Re-densified): {score_stage2:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Score Change from Stage 1: {score_stage2 - score_stage1:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Overall Score Change from SOTA base: {score_stage2 - score_initial_sota:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)

    # --- 3. Verify KKT for the final re-densified solution ---
    print("\n===== KKT Analysis of Final Re-densified Solution =====", file=sys.stdout)
    df_final_kkt = extract_slsqp_kkt_multipliers(res_stage2, N=N_CIRCLES, tol=TOL_VAL, atol_slack=ATOL_SLACK)
    final_active_count = df_final_kkt['is_active'].sum()
    print(f"Total active constraints identified in final solution: {final_active_count}", file=sys.stdout)
    print("\n--- Top KKT Multipliers (Final SLSQP, first 10) ---", file=sys.stdout)
    print(df_final_kkt.head(10).to_string(), file=sys.stdout)

    # Check status of targeted pair (13,17) - should ideally be inactive
    target_pair_info = df_final_kkt[
        (df_final_kkt['constraint_type'] == 'pair') & 
        (df_final_kkt['id1'] == 13) & 
        (df_final_kkt['id2_or_label'] == 17)
    ]
    if not target_pair_info.empty:
        print(f"\nStatus of targeted pair (13,17) in final solution:", file=sys.stdout)
        print(target_pair_info.to_string(index=False), file=sys.stdout)
    else:
        print("\nTargeted pair (13,17) not found in KKT analysis or not a pair constraint type.", file=sys.stdout)

    print("\n--- Two-Stage KKT-Guided Nudging Experiment Complete ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    return nudged_centers_stage2, final_radii_nudged_stage2
